{{Top|leg}}
A '''shock cannon''' was a [[Cannon/Legends|cannon]] that fired a beam similar to that of a [[Composite-beam laser|beam cannon]], although the beams of shock cannons lasted a much shorter period of time and fired at a faster rate. They did very little damage against a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]], although they were capable of damaging [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to a degree. The amount of damage dealt out to a ship was determined by how close the ship was to the cannons, and what type of ship it was. Only a direct hit at close ranges would take a ship out with one hit, and at medium to long ranges, it would take multiple hits, making shock cannons a bit less effective out to longer ranges than their beam cannon counter parts.

{{Weapon-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Shock cannons replaced the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] of [[Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter/Legends|Alpha-3 Nimbus-class V-wing starfighter]] in ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''.
